title: Oracle queries within a time bound
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language over its alphabet, let $x$ be an input word, and let $t$ be a nonnegative integer. The list of queries made within this bound consists of the query strings in the configurations reached after $s$ steps, for each integer $s$ with $0\le s<t$ for which the machine is in its query state.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
An oracle language over the machine's alphabet
